verdict.overall: The clearest shift since Sunday is PLTR and NVDA both flipping from neutral to supportive for the nearest expiry, and TSLA's near-term opposing stance easing to neutral - but this comes alongside a heavy earnings calendar (PLTR today, APP tomorrow, ZETA and AMAT mid-month, NVDA 11-17) that can override any magnet level. SPY, QQQ, AVGO and AMAT look steadiest for range-based swings with barely any change since Sunday, while PLTR, APP, ZETA and TSLA carry the most event risk and very pricey options, so confidence in the friendlier scores is shaky rather than rising.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: little changed overall - the 11-06 expiry eased from opposing to neutral (floor up to $380, ceiling down to $410), but 11-13 through 11-27 still show opposing gravity near $375, capping the uptrend. Options are pricey; next earnings isn't until 2027.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: stronger near term - the 11-06 expiry flipped from neutral to supportive, magnet easing to $187.5 and ceiling down to $195, floor steady at $180. PLTR reports earnings today, so a big move could override these levels, and options are very pricey.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: stronger near term - 11-06 flipped from neutral to supportive, magnet trimmed to $210 and ceiling to $220, floor steady at $200. Still a downtrend with bearish momentum, and earnings land 2026-11-17, just before the 11-20 expiry, adding risk. Options stay pricey throughout.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed - all four expiries stay neutral, with small magnet drift down (roughly $31.50-$33) and the 11-06 ceiling trimmed to $34. Earnings hit 2026-11-09, right before the 11-13 expiry. Options are very pricey, so this isn't a calm setup.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed - levels are nearly identical, staying neutral in a wide $350-$450 floor-to-ceiling band across expiries. Earnings land 2026-11-12, just before the 11-13 expiry, adding risk to an already weak downtrend. Options price fair to pricey.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed - all four expiries stay neutral with only small trims to the near-term magnet ($345) and floor ($292.5). Trend is down with bearish momentum, but earnings aren't until December, outside this window. Options price fair to pricey.
tickers.GOOGL: No Sunday baseline. GOOGL is in a downtrend with a very oversold reading, all four expiries neutral, floors near $265-$275 and ceilings rising from $290 to $300 further out. Options are cheap here, and earnings already passed, so no event risk in this window.
tickers.APP: Since Sunday: slightly softer - magnets and ceilings drifted a few dollars lower across expiries (11-06 magnet now $270, 11-13 ceiling down to $240). APP reports earnings tomorrow, a major risk given price sits well below the $270+ magnets. Options are very pricey throughout.
tickers.BE: No Sunday baseline. BE is in a downtrend with bearish momentum, all four expiries neutral, floor holding at $200 and ceilings near $220-235. Earnings already passed in October, so no event risk ahead. Options price fair to pricey.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - near-term (11-06) ceiling trimmed to $770 (£109.81) and magnet to $764 (£108.95), floor steady at $750 (£106.96). All four expiries stay neutral in a downtrend with no earnings risk; options are pricey throughout.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - near-term (11-06) magnet trimmed to $714 (£80.26, rough since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq), ceiling steady near $769 (£83.96), and the 11-13 floor widened down to $650 (£75.96). All expiries stay neutral in a downtrend; no earnings risk.
